Chip rotation from NVDA to laggards likely. Bond markets choppy on hyperscaler supply. Diesel spike pressures consumer names.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle (NVIDIA-Groq, data-center insurance, Chinese AI rotation) supports tech leadership. $40T debt and EM rotation create structural bond headwinds. Energy transition (Chevron Venezuela, OPEC+ discipline) supports commodity prices. Defense spending structurally elevated. Consumer wage gap is the key swing factor for 2027.
